mission: Arrive at Veranthos, establish a tactical position, and make a final attempt to keep Torin with the group.
why_now: Arrival at Veranthos is the endpoint every chapter has been building toward. The primary wound must be confronted physically. Veraine is already there.
conflict: Ben vs. overwhelming scale of the primary wound
turning_point: Torin's expression as they approach the wound source — not certainty or determination, but longing. Ben knows the turn is hours away.
emotional_trajectory: Every character carrying their full weight into the climax
notes: Group lands on Veranthos. Veraine already at the wound source. Final conversations. Torin's expression: longing. Ben knows the turn is coming — hours, not days.
